Name: Default Animal Skin Replacer
Author: BussinBungus
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/Tk6ySOI.png[/img]
This mod was designed for those playing with new or updated farm animal mods, like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20043]Elle's Cuter Animals[/url] or the skins version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Farm Animal Facelift[/url]. It does nothing on its own, but when skins are installed it assigns a random skin to existing farm animals with default skins. This is helpful if you're playing pre-1.6 farms with the new animal mods, or if you want the two starting chickens on the Meadowlands Farm to use installed skins.

Version 1.1 adds three new commands:
[list]
[*]dasr_reset <name/all> - Resets farm animals to the default skin. "dasr_reset Bessie" would reset an animal named Bessie, while "dasr_reset all" would reset all animals.
[*]dasr_reroll <name/all> - Rerolls skins for default animals. Since this command only works on default animals, any animals you wish to reroll must first be reset with the above command!
[*]dasr_pick <name> <skin> - Picks a specific skin for an animal. "dasr_pick Porky tamworth" would give a pig named Porky the "tamworth" skin from Farm Animal Facelift. This command does not require animals to first be reset.
[/list]
[img]https://imgur.com/Zs2Ygje.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6﻿+
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0+
[/list]
[img]https://imgur.com/UrOQoB5.png[/img]
[list]
[*]If installing manually, extract the mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]If using a mod manager, download using your mod manager and install.
[*]To uninstall, simply delete the mod from your mods folder.
[/list]
[img]https://imgur.com/U5cy51K.png[/img]
Thanks to dragonflyonthewall for the mod idea, and to everyone that makes cute farm animal mods!

[img]https://imgur.com/4i58lt8.png[/img]
